packet.title: XSLT 4.0 test driver (implementation) — Early
packet.summary: Adds the sxml-xslt-test driver, which reads the xslt40-test catalog with its dependencies, environments and assertions, and a ctest slice list tests/xslt/slice.txt with a baseline.

body.p: After , . Owns new tests/xslt/driver/, docs/QT4_CATALOG.md (its xslt40-test section). Program sxml-xslt-test on the CLI framework, linking sxml_qt4_driver_library for assertions, reports and documents. Reads third_party/xslt40-test/catalog.xml (): <dependencies> wrappers (spec XSLT40, the feature exclusions, a case spec replaces the set's), environments with source (file, inline content, uri), and entries, <test> with stylesheets, packages, initial-template, initial-mode, initial-function, param (static or not), output serialize="yes"; assertions of QT4 plus assert-result-document, assert-message, assert-serialization, assert-serialization-error (assert-warning and assert-posture-and-sweep not run). list works now; run reports "unsupported" until 4.15. Done when the 8,700 in-scope cases resolve and a ctest slice list tests/xslt/slice.txt (about 150 cases over the core sets) is chosen with a baseline file. Done 2026-10-17 (): tests/xslt/driver/ (sxml-xslt-test list and run, a sibling of sxml-qt4), tests/xslt/slice.txt (154 cases), tests/xslt/slice-baseline.txt (0); all 13,867 cases resolve, 8,728 in scope; run says "XSLT not implemented" until 4.15.
